title: FoDropBooster
description: Timed personal, team, world, and global boosters for drops and FoLevels XP.
body:
![Cover Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/705fde20cc38b3d9468f601f7fee819e3b31be12.png)
**Give players clean, configurable booster items for drops, FoDrops rewards, team boosts, and FoLevels XP.**

FoDropBooster adds timed booster items that server owners can use for crates, events, store rewards, quests, and progression boosts. Boosters can target normal drops or FoLevels XP, run personally or across a team, world, or the whole server, and show active time through a polished bossbar.

![Active booster with bossbar countdown](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbb2991fda5461bfefef6c9444d51418f21a0be6.png)

![Booster Item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8e31d91ff36568d7fde5d7df2cfaaa7dcaafbce.png)

## Features

- Create preset or custom booster items for personal, team, world, and global boosts.
- Boost player-owned rewards from block breaks, mob kills, fishing, shearing, and explosions.
- Add optional FoLevels XP boosters for leveling servers that want timed XP events.
- Show active multipliers and remaining time with configurable bossbars.
- Use the GUI editor to manage booster presets, event coverage, disabled worlds, and active boosts.
- Support FoTeams team boosters and an optional passive team-size multiplier.

![Booster preset editor showing multiplier, duration, scope, and target](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d7b375123d168cd541669401f6aff17ab083ed7.png)

![Active booster management screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43dc19d830b6e8da3f616a429c88c867534585ba.png)

## Dependencies

- **Optional:** FoDrops, FoAutoCollect, FoTeams, FoLevels, PlaceholderAPI
- FoLevels is only needed for FoLevels XP booster targets.
- FoTeams is only needed for team boosters and the passive team multiplier.
- FoDrops & FoAutocollect work together with FoDropBooster, making drops fully editable.

## Commands

- `/fodropboosteradmin version` - Check the installed version and update status.
- `/fodropboosteradmin reload` - Reload plugin files.
- `/fodropboosteradmin editor` - Open the booster editor GUI.
- `/fodropboosteradmin give <player> preset <id> [amount]` - Give a configured booster preset.
- `/fodropboosteradmin give <player> custom [drop|xp] <personal|team|global|world> <multiplier> <duration> [world|current] [amount]` - Give a custom booster item.
- `/fodropboosteradmin removeactive <personal|team|world|global|id> <target>` - Remove matching active boosters.
- `/dropboosterbossbar [on|off]` - Toggle your personal booster bossbar.

## Permissions

- `fodropbooster.admin` - Access admin commands and the editor.
- `fodropbooster.togglebossbar` - Toggle the personal booster bossbar.

## Placeholders
- `%fodropbooster_active%` - Best display boost multiplier for the player, with x suffix.
- `%fodropbooster_active_raw%` - Best display boost multiplier for the player, without x suffix.
- `%fodropbooster_dropactive%` - Effective drop boost multiplier for the player, with x suffix.
- `%fodropbooster_dropactive_raw%` - Effective drop boost multiplier for the player, without x suffix.
- `%fodropbooster_xpactive%` - Effective FoLevels XP boost multiplier for the player, with x suffix.
- `%fodropbooster_xpactive_raw%` - Effective FoLevels XP boost multiplier for the player, without x suffix.
- `%fodropbooster_folevelsactive%` - Alias of xpactive, with x suffix.
- `%fodropbooster_folevelsactive_raw%` - Alias of xpactive, without x suffix.
- `%fodropbooster_teammultiplier%` - Team multiplier part of the player's displayed boost, with x suffix.
- `%fodropbooster_teammultiplier_raw%` - Team multiplier part of the player's displayed boost, without x suffix.
